name: Detect Thoughts
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You temporarily gain the ability to read the thoughts of those around you. When you cast this spell, you become aware of the presence of each creature within short range that has a WITS score of 1 or higher.

While the effect lasts, you may spend an action to read the surface thoughts of one of the creatures you detected. You learn what is most on its mind in that moment.

Once you have read the surface thoughts of a creature in this way, you may spend an action to attempt to probe deeper. Roll Awareness vs Awareness. On a win, for 1 round, you gain insight into its reasoning and emotional state as well as anything that looms large in its mind. On a loss, the spell ends. Win or loss, the creature knows you are probing into its mind.

Describe how you experience this sense.
successes:
✨: On a win, you also learn of one significant hope or fear the creature has. On a loss, the creature checks a Condition.

🌞: On a win, you may ask one question and receive an honest answer from the creature's mind in the form of a memory or series of memories, per GM discretion. On a loss, the creature checks a Condition.
